about: - Story Ivalice—a kingdom blessed by the light of the gods and ruled by the Two-headed Lion. A year after her defeat to Ordallia in the Fifty Years' War, the king succumbed to malady, leaving a mere boy of two to ascend the throne.
Whoever was named regent would rule in truth, and thus emerged two rival candidates: dukes Goltanna and Larg, whose deeds during the war had earned them great renown.
Goltanna the Black Lion and Larg the White Lion were destined to clash, and the resulting conflict would come to be known as the War of the Lions.
Against this backdrop appear Ramza, third son of House Beoulve, one of Ivalice's leading military families, and his childhood companion Delita, a commoner raised amongst nobles.
As they endeavor to chart a course through this tumultuous age, a mighty current draws them ever closer to the abyss.
- Combat Lead your party in exhilarating encounters where strategic positioning and forward planning determine the outcome.
summary: The groundbreaking tactical RPG makes its long-awaited return.
